title: The Mixed Laundry Loads
story: Lina carried a full laundry basket down to the shared machines on Sunday morning. She put her white shirts in one machine and her dark trousers in another. Her neighbour Rosa arrived with a red basket and asked which machine was free. Lina pointed to the small machine by the window. When the machines stopped, Lina opened a door. She pulled out a green sweater she had never owned. Rosa laughed and held up Lina's blue towel. They had swapped the wet loads by mistake. They spread everything on a big table and sorted each item by colour. Lina found her socks inside Rosa's basket. Rosa found a school shirt with Lina's name inside the collar. They folded the clean piles and thanked each other. Lina wrote her name on a piece of tape and stuck it to her basket. Next Sunday she checked the tape before she pressed start.
